name: Mission 4 phase 0-1 diagnostics from frozen round-3 baseline

x0_detectability.population: three-source source-events in matrix baseline report

labels.detectable_3_nodes: at least three nodes with source-aligned measured tracks during source clip within 10 degrees of truth (unchanged 3A definition)
labels.bearing_available_3_nodes: at least three nodes with any measured bearing window during source clip (new companion label)
labels.track_within10_any_time_3_nodes: at least three nodes with any track window within 10 degrees of truth at any time

node_stage_breakdown: within 10 degrees at any track time
failure_buckets: no bearing at 3+ nodes in clip

x1_node_count_reconciliation.population: matrix baseline runs grouped by realism, source count and matrix_node_count
x1_node_count_reconciliation.note: Node-8 may be absent because 3A baseline runtime cut excluded node_count=8 density cases.
